item.title: Refund Request
item.body: Dear TRAE Support Team, This is a follow-up reminder for my refund application submitted on April 20, 2026. I have not received any reply from your team. My account details: User ID: 7643483765750760469 Payment email: songchaemin2005@gmal.com Total payment amount: USD 10.00 Payment time: May 25, 2026 I solemnly and legally confirm: I have NEVER logged in, activated, used or enjoyed ANY paid subscription services & content of TRAE after this purchase. This subscription is 100% completely unused. According to your official public refund policy (https://docs.trae.ai/ide/billing): Unused Pro subscription within refund period is eligible for FULL refund. I fully meet all legal and official refund conditions. Payment receipt screenshot is attached. Please process my full USD 10 refund immediately within 24 hours, and reply with refund progress & completion time. If I still receive no response or refusal, I will submit official complaints through payment channel appeal, GitHub public issue platform, consumer rights protection channels and social media exposure. Best regards, Chaemin Song
